title: Virtua Fighter Crossroads Game Streams Character Overview Trailer
content: Sega revealed a character overview trailer for its Virtua Fighter Crossroads game on Tuesday exploring the staff's behind-the-scenes character creation process. The game will launch in 2027.

title: Bananya Franchise Gets Cat-Collecting Mobile Game for Release in Summer
content: TMS announced on Monday it is partnering with Crunchyroll to launch the Bananya Buddies mobile game, inspired by the Bananya character, for iOS and Android this summer exclusively on the Crunchyroll Game Vault. The is available for pre-registration on Google Play now.

title: Studio Ghibli’s Masterpiece, Spirited Away Confirms New Stage Adaptation Release in North America
content: Even several decades since it was established, Studio Ghibli remains one of the most iconic animation studios of all time. Ever since its establishment in 1985, every film released under its banner has been praised for its striking visuals, rich storytelling, and deep emotional impact.

title: Bleach’s Final Season Just Had an Impressive Box Office Debut Weekend

title: Hiroshi Shimomoto's Delinquent Gacha Manga Ends
content: Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ published the final chapter of Hiroshi Shimomoto 's Delinquent Gacha ( Gachankee ) manga on Tuesday. The third and final compiled book volume will ship on September 4. The manga had entered its last arc on June 16.
